description: Conqueror's Legguards Level 60 Bring Ouro's Intact Hide, 2 Idols of Death, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Kandrostrasz inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest. Requirements: - Ouro's Intact Hide - Idol of Death x 2 - Bronze Scarab x 5 - Ivory Scarab x 5 - Brood of Nozdormu:
